correctness.rationale: For C_(d,e)⊂P³_C, deg=de and 2g-2=de(d+e-4), so a generic tangent-plane pencil and Riemann–Hurwitz give deg(C^∨)=de(d+e-2). Thus 2m²=3n(n+1), mod 3 gives 3|m, and x=2n+1,u=m/3 yields x²−24u²=1. Fundamental unit 5+√24 generates all positive Pell solutions, first (m,n)=(3,2) is the same unordered bidegree. Independently iterated through k=5: (30,24)->1800; (297,242)->176418; (2940,2400)->17287200. Ratio m/n→√(3/2). This is an infinite Pell proof, not an inference from 2≤m,n≤5000 regression.
